scope.zh: 聚焦影响AI芯片、存储、设备与材料的出口管制、关税、产业政策与反垄断事件；不含AI模型监管（如欧盟AI法案）。条目按日期排列，每条标注证据级别与未核实之处。
scope.en: Covers export controls, tariffs, industrial policy and antitrust events that bear on AI chips, memory, equipment and materials. AI-model regulation (e.g. the EU AI Act) is out of scope. Entries are dated and carry an evidence level and what was not verified.

primary-read.zh: 已打开并阅读官方或公司原始文件
primary-read.en: Official or company primary document opened and read

primary-located.zh: 已定位官方文件（联邦公报等），细节取自摘要
primary-located.en: Official document located (e.g. Federal Register); details taken from summaries

secondary-authoritative.zh: 权威二手来源（如国会研究服务处）
secondary-authoritative.en: Authoritative secondary source (e.g. Congressional Research Service)

secondary.zh: 律所、智库或媒体摘要，未核对原文
secondary.en: Law-firm, think-tank or press summaries; primary text not checked

title.zh: 美国《芯片与科学法案》签署
title.en: US CHIPS and Science Act signed

summary.zh: 拨款约527亿美元用于半导体制造、研发、人才培养与盟友协作（FY2022–FY2027），并含25%的先进制造投资税收抵免。
summary.en: Appropriates about $52.7B for semiconductor manufacturing, R&D, workforce and allied coordination (FY2022–FY2027), plus a 25% advanced-manufacturing investment tax credit.

sources.label: Congressional Research Service: CHIPS Act FAQ (R47523)
EY: CHIPS and Science Act tax credits

caveat.zh: 奖励发放与后续政策走向本页未核查。
caveat.en: Award disbursement and later policy direction were not checked here.

note.zh: 相关性为编辑判断：英特尔代工产能与客户承诺问答。
note.en: Editorial relation: Intel foundry capacity and customer-commitment questions.

title.zh: BIS 发布先进计算与半导体制造出口管制
title.en: BIS advanced-computing and semiconductor-manufacturing export controls

summary.zh: 限制中国购买和制造部分高端芯片：先进计算与超算最终用途管制，以及部分半导体制造设备管制；分阶段生效（10月7日、10月12日、10月21日）。
summary.en: Restricts the PRC's ability to buy and make certain high-end chips: advanced-computing and supercomputer end-use controls plus controls on some chipmaking items, effective in phases (Oct 7, Oct 12, Oct 21, 2022).

caveat.zh: 规则文本与受控性能阈值未在此核对；见联邦公报。
caveat.en: Rule text and control thresholds were not checked here; see the Federal Register.

note.zh: 相关报告为同一市场背景，页面不一定讨论该规则。
note.en: Related reports share the market context; they do not necessarily discuss this rule.

date_note.zh: 荷兰政府3月8日公布方案，措施自2023年9月起生效；各来源对具体日期说法不一。
date_note.en: Dutch government announced plans on 8 Mar 2023; measures took effect from Sept 2023; sources differ on exact dates.

title.zh: 荷兰、日本跟进半导体设备出口管制
title.en: Netherlands and Japan add chipmaking-equipment controls

summary.zh: 2023年1月美、荷、日达成谅解后，荷兰对最先进DUV浸没式光刻设备要求许可，日本对23类设备实施管制。
summary.en: After a January 2023 US–Dutch–Japanese understanding, the Netherlands required licences for the most advanced DUV immersion tools and Japan controlled 23 equipment types.

sources.label: CSIS: Japan and the Netherlands announce plans
ASML statement on additional export controls
Mayer Brown: Japan and Netherlands restrictions

caveat.zh: 发布与生效日期来源不一致，引用前请核对荷兰政府公告。
caveat.en: Publication and effective dates differ across sources; check Dutch government publications before citing.

note.zh: 相关性为编辑判断：ASML EUV/设备瓶颈问答。
note.en: Editorial relation: ASML EUV and equipment-bottleneck questions.

date_note.zh: 商务部7月3日公告，8月1日起实施。
date_note.en: MOFCOM announced on 3 Jul 2023; effective 1 Aug 2023.

title.zh: 中国对镓、锗实施出口许可
title.en: China adds export licensing for gallium and germanium

summary.zh: 商务部对镓、锗相关物项实施出口许可，被广泛视为对2022年10月至2023年7月期间一系列管制的回应；2024年12月进一步限制对美出口。
summary.en: MOFCOM introduced export licensing for gallium and germanium items, widely read as a response to the Oct 2022–Jul 2023 controls; a Dec 2024 directive tightened exports to the US.

caveat.zh: 未取得商务部原始公告；2025年底的暂停与到期安排说法不一。
caveat.en: Primary MOFCOM notices were not retrieved; the late-2025 suspension and expiry arrangements are described inconsistently.

note.zh: 站内暂无直接对应的财报问答。
note.en: No directly matching earnings question on this site.

date_note.zh: 10月17日发布，10月25日刊于联邦公报，11月17日生效。
date_note.en: Released 17 Oct; published in the Federal Register 25 Oct; effective 17 Nov 2023.

title.zh: BIS 更新先进计算与设备管制
title.en: BIS updates advanced-computing and equipment controls

summary.zh: 两项临时最终规则扩展并收紧2022年10月管制（先进计算物项、超算与半导体最终用途、半导体制造物项）。
summary.en: Two interim final rules expand and tighten the October 2022 controls (advanced-computing items, supercomputer and semiconductor end uses, semiconductor manufacturing items).

sources.label: Federal Register: Export Controls on Semiconductor Manufacturing Items (2023-23049)
BIS press release: Commerce strengthens restrictions

caveat.zh: 性能阈值细节来自二手摘要，未在联邦公报原文中核对。
caveat.en: Performance-threshold details come from secondary summaries and were not checked in the rule text.

title.zh: BIS 对 HBM、设备与实体清单加严
title.en: BIS adds HBM, equipment and Entity List controls

summary.zh: 临时最终规则将高带宽内存（HBM）纳入管制并新增24类制造设备与3类软件工具管制；同时新增约140家实体清单实体。
summary.en: An interim final rule controls high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and adds 24 types of manufacturing equipment and 3 software-tool types; about 140 Entity List additions came the same day.

sources.label: Alston & Bird: Export controls on computing and semiconductor items

caveat.zh: 数量与阈值来自律所摘要；原规则文本未在此打开。
caveat.en: Counts and thresholds come from law-firm summaries; the rule text was not opened here.

note.zh: 相关性为编辑判断：HBM 客户资质与出货问答。
note.en: Editorial relation: HBM customer-qualification and shipment questions.

title.zh: 中国对七种中重稀土及磁体实施出口许可
title.en: China adds export licensing on seven rare-earth elements and magnets

summary.zh: 2025年4月4日起，七种中重稀土元素及相关磁体出口需许可；后续范围与暂停安排来源说法不一。
summary.en: From 4 Apr 2025, exports of seven medium and heavy rare-earth elements and related magnets require licences; later scope changes and suspensions are described inconsistently.

sources.label: Global Trade Alert: China's critical-raw-material export controls

caveat.zh: 未取得商务部原始公告；2025年10月后的扩大与延期安排需核对官方公告。
caveat.en: Primary MOFCOM notices were not retrieved; check official notices for the post-Oct 2025 expansion and delay.

note.zh: 站内暂无直接对应的财报问答。
note.en: No directly matching earnings question on this site.

title.en: H20 exports to China require a licence (NVIDIA 8-K)

summary.zh: 美国政府要求向中国（含香港、澳门）及 D:5 国家出口 H20 需许可，且“在可预见的将来”持续；NVIDIA 预计一季度最多约55亿美元相关费用。2025年8月起部分获准向特定中国客户出货（据其后续 8-K）。
summary.en: The US government required a licence for H20 exports to China (incl. Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries “for the indefinite future”; NVIDIA expected up to about $5.5B of charges in the quarter. Some licences for certain China customers followed from Aug 2025 (per later 8-Ks).

caveat.zh: 8月许可与最终费用4.5亿美元以后续公司文件为准，本页只读取了4月8-K。
caveat.en: The August licences and the final charge ($4.5B) rest on later company filings; only the April 8-K was read here.

title.zh: BIS 撤销“AI 扩散规则”并发布指引
title.en: BIS rescinds the AI Diffusion Rule and issues guidance

summary.zh: 撤销2025年1月15日发布、原定5月15日生效的AI扩散规则；承诺将来发布替代规则，并就华为昇腾芯片、AI模型训练最终用途与供应链转运风险发布三份指引。
summary.en: Rescinds the AI Diffusion Rule (issued 15 Jan 2025, due to bind from 15 May); promises a replacement rule and issues three guidance documents on Huawei Ascend chips, AI-model training end uses and diversion risks.

caveat.zh: 替代规则是否已发布本页未核查。
caveat.en: Whether a replacement rule has since been published was not checked here.

note.zh: 相关报告为同一市场背景。
note.en: Related report shares the market context.

title.zh: 市场监管总局初步认定 NVIDIA 违反 Mellanox 并购附加条件
title.en: SAMR preliminary finding on NVIDIA's Mellanox merger conditions

summary.zh: 市场监管总局宣布初步调查认为 NVIDIA 违反2020年 Mellanox 收购的附加条件；调查继续，NVIDIA 称遵守法律并将配合。
summary.en: China's SAMR announced a preliminary finding that NVIDIA breached conditions attached to its 2020 Mellanox acquisition; the probe continued and NVIDIA said it complies with the law.

caveat.zh: 最终处罚情况本页未核查；10-Q 原文未在此逐段阅读。
caveat.en: Final penalties were not checked; the 10-Q text was not read line by line here.

date_note.zh: 1月14日签署，1月15日起对窄类先进计算芯片征收。
date_note.en: Signed 14 Jan; the duty applies from 15 Jan 2026 to a narrow category of advanced chips.

title.zh: 第232条款：对特定先进计算芯片征收25%关税
title.en: Section 232: 25% tariff on a narrow set of advanced chips

summary.zh: 总统公告11002对特定先进计算芯片及衍生品征收25%关税；美国数据中心、研发、初创企业等用途获豁免；第二阶段（更广关税与抵扣机制）视谈判而定。
summary.en: Proclamation 11002 imposes a 25% duty on certain advanced computing chips and derivatives; US data-centre, R&D and startup uses are exempt; a broader phase two with an offset programme depends on negotiations.

sources.label: CBP CSMS guidance on Section 232 semiconductor duties

caveat.zh: 第二阶段是否已实施本页未核查；请查联邦公报与 CBP 通告。
caveat.en: Whether phase two has been imposed was not checked; see the Federal Register and CBP notices.

note.zh: 站内暂无直接对应的财报问答。
note.en: No directly matching earnings question on this site.

title.zh: BIS：H200 / MI325X 对华许可改为个案审查
title.en: BIS: H200 / MI325X licences to China move to case-by-case review

summary.zh: 《先进计算商品许可审查政策修订》将总处理性能低于21,000且DRAM带宽低于6,500 GB/s的芯片（如 H200、MI325X）由“推定拒绝”改为个案审查；仅限美国直接出口，转口与境外转让仍推定拒绝；并非通用许可。
summary.en: “Revision to License Review Policy for Advanced Computing Commodities” moves chips below 21,000 total processing performance and 6,500 GB/s DRAM bandwidth (e.g. H200, MI325X) from presumption of denial to case-by-case review; direct US exports only, reexports and in-country transfers stay presumption of denial; not a general licence.

caveat.zh: 阈值与条件取自律所摘要与公报检索结果，未逐条核对规则全文；数量上限、买家名单等来自博客，未采纳。
caveat.en: Thresholds and conditions come from law-firm summaries and the Federal Register record located in search; the full rule text was not checked. Volume caps and buyer lists reported by blogs are not adopted.
